title: Move TutorAuditLogReadRepository/TutorGrantRepository interfaces into domain/repositories/ to remove the data→presentation import
rule: Placement guide ("New repository interface → domain/repositories/") / layering
why: coding-standards.md's placement guide says a new repository interface belongs at `domain/repositories/<name>_repository.dart`. None of tutoring's three repository interfaces live there: TutorAuditLogReadRepository is defined inside presentation/providers/audit_log_providers.dart, so the DATA-layer implementation (firestore_audit_log_read_repository.dart) has to import a PRESENTATION file to satisfy `implements` — the exact inverse of the documented data-flow direction — pulling Riverpod Provider definitions and an unrelated stub class into what should be a lean, presentation-agnostic data module and complicating isolated unit-testing of the repository (Feathers seam). TutorGrantRepository is at least kept in domain/ but lives in a use_cases file instead of domain/repositories/, the same underlying placement drift.
recommendation: Create lib/features/tutoring/domain/repositories/tutor_audit_log_repository.dart (read) and tutor_grant_repository.dart, move the three interfaces there, and update data-layer implementations plus presentation/providers imports accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: TutorAuditLogReadRepository, TutorAuditLogRepository, TutorGrantRepository all resolve from lib/features/tutoring/domain/repositories/.

corrections: Strengthens, not weakens: real circular import exists between the two cited files; 3 interfaces are misplaced, not 2.
